news.headline: Sources: Eagles' Jalen Hurts, out indefinitely with blood clot, not planned for IR
news.description: The Eagles are not planning to put Jalen Hurts on injured reserve, sources told ESPN, even as he remains sidelined indefinitely with a superficial blood clot.

news.headline: Source: Patriots likely to activate WR A.J. Brown for Sunday's game vs. Jets
news.description: Patriots wide receiver A.J. Brown is likely to be activated after missing the past four games with a right high ankle sprain, a source told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

news.headline: Eagles' Saquon Barkley ruled out; DeVonta Smith likely to return
news.description: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Panthers with a hamstring injury, but it appears WR DeVonta Smith will return.

news.headline: Packers' Josh Jacobs eligible to return next week amid investigation
news.description: Packers RB Josh Jacobs will be removed from the commissioner exempt list Monday, the league announced, making him eligible to practice and play next week.

news.headline: Jalen Hurts' health bigger than football, as teammates, coach detail QB concern
news.description: Eagles coach Nick Sirianni declined to offer much detail about Jalen Hurts' health, instead focusing on his connection with the quarterback.

news.headline: Seahawks sticking with Sam Darnold as starter despite INTs
news.description: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald is standing behind Sam Darnold as the team's starting quarterback despite his seven interceptions over the past four games.

news.headline: Ravens rule out QB Lamar Jackson; Tyler Huntley to start vs. Browns
news.description: The Ravens have ruled quarterback Lamar Jackson out for a second straight week, elevating Tyler Huntley to the starting role for Sunday's game in Cleveland.

build.name: Dynasty Juggernaut
build.about: Strong now and strong later: top-third points and top-third dynasty value without an old core.
plan: Win now without spending the future: trade depth and later picks for upgrades, not young starters.
Sell any starter about to age out a year early while he still has value.
Keep one or two firsts a year so the window never closes.
reasons: 1st of 14 in points a week the rest of the way (214.7)
31% of player value is 24 or younger (9th most)

build.name: All-In Veterans
build.about: Built to win this year on older starters; the window is one or two seasons.
plan: Push every chip in: future picks are worth more to you as points now.
Buy proven vets that rebuilders are dumping at a discount.
Plan the exit: sell the oldest starters the offseason after the title run, before their value drops.
reasons: 4th of 14 in points a week the rest of the way (194.1)
30% of player value is 24 or younger (10th most)

build.name: Playoff Bubble
build.about: Middle of the pack on points but in or near a playoff spot.
plan: Fix the one or two weakest starting spots; a small upgrade swings a bubble team.
Pay with depth and seconds, not firsts, unless the upgrade makes you a top-three team.
If the record slips below the line by midseason, flip to a retool and sell the vets.
reasons: 6th of 14 in points a week the rest of the way (177.4)
